stock_sampling: sha256(stock_code) % 8 == 0, no list_status filter; lake availability remains selection bias
event_calendar: last benchmark session of each COMPLETE prior month; endpoint month excluded; eligible bars only; 2017 warmup and 2018+ decisions
turnover: positive daily float-turnover decimal, sources require >=100 same-date validation pairs and >=98% within5%; monthly shares never forward-filled
rank: (rolling253 average-rank(current)-1)/252; requires full window; current excluded, ties midrank
unavailable_controls: PIT daily real market cap (monthly basic insufficient)
inference: date-equal differences; fixed-seed circular block bootstrap, block=horizon+20, 500 repetitions; minimum20 paired dates; Holm-adjusted tests across published factor/horizon/split variants
shadow_high_missing: retain original weights, audit unknown; no promotion with unknown selected exposures
D_policy: High crowding blocks new purchases of actual shares, without label-triggered liquidation. Requires an exact execution guard; target-weight proxy is not counted as D.
F_policy: constant scale calibrated on development-only preselected ledger; if none, no F replay, never fit on validation
limitations: Current lake QFQ is retrospective; input PIT not independently audited.
Sample breadth is NOT full-market/industry breadth.
No frontend change until incremental risk evidence and PIT gates support it.
